lines.zh: 两条长腿跨出去，一步顶三步
lines.en: Two long legs carry me three strides at a time.
When I run, my neck goes out first.

lines.zh: 猴子面包树的影子底下走
lines.en: I walk under the baobab's shadow.

lines.zh: 沙地上留一串细长的印
lines.en: Thin prints trail behind me on the sand.
I don't fly; I run faster than flight.
My toes spread so I don't sink in sand.

lines.zh: 脖子一低一高，像在啄地
lines.en: My neck dips and rises like pecking.
The wind lifts my feathers.
We walk in a group; the steps are loud.

lines.zh: 跑起来的时候，后面全是沙
lines.en: When we run, sand rises behind.
The trees are too dense for me.
Keep up back there, don't fall behind.
The bare legs make me look thin.
I curve around toward the water hole.
I take this path every day.
The sun is fierce, so I walk slower.
I stand and swing my neck side to side.
In every flock, a few just stare.
I puff my feathers to look bigger.
I dip my head and peck at the sand.
Big eyes, long sight.
My legs are bare and cool.
I remember that tree.
My breathing is low.
I can stand like this a long while.
The wind musses my feathers.

lines.zh: 你比树还矮，我不用低头
lines.en: You're shorter than the tree; I needn't bow.
You stand there; I watch.
My kick lands heavy.
Are you going to reach for me?

lines.zh: 我认得这个地方，不认得你
lines.en: I know this place, not you.

lines.zh: 眼睛太大了，你看着不舒服吧
lines.en: Big eyes can be unsettling, no?
You humans always want to ride me.
Step off, I'm eating.
I won't run unless you move first.
This sand is ours.
I back off, legs shaking.
That knocked me off balance.
I didn't cry out.
The skin on my leg scraped.
I hopped twice to steady.
The pain pulls my neck in.
I retreat toward the flock.
Hit again and I run.
Leaves, I like them.
That bit of grass isn't enough.
Scatter seed and I'll come.
I eat plants, not meat.
You hold it too high; I can't reach.
Put it down, stop waving.
This one smells good.
Stand back and I'll eat.
Don't rush me; one bite at a time.
Water interests me more than food.
Hit me and your shoulder hurts.
One kick of mine could put you down.
You touched my feathers.
I stepped half aside.
We jostle in the flock.
Leg bone is hard; it knocks.
Back off and I'll turn.
This patch of sand is too narrow.
Don't shove me; I kick.

lines.zh: 脖子弯下去，算是打招呼
lines.en: I bow my neck as a greeting.
Two of us run with matched strides.

lines.zh: 沙子里的窝，是我们挖的
lines.en: The nest in the sand is ours.

lines.zh: 春天的时候，事情就多了
lines.en: In spring there's a lot going on.
We take turns sitting.
That one has the whitest feathers.
Don't come near the nest.

lines.zh: 跑起来的时候，尘土一起
lines.en: We raise dust together.
In the flock, we don't split.
Leave, no people needed here.
I peck it up and drop it.
I can't swallow that.
I hold it in my beak, steady.
This isn't food.
I kick it aside.

lines.zh: 掉下的东西，我们分着看
lines.en: We all inspect what falls.
This pebble is too small.
I carried it a while.
Not interested; I'm off.
Something's swaying over there.
I see a shadow.
I stretch my neck to see.
That's not one of us.
I run first, and I run fastest.
Direction set.
I raise sand to hide myself.
The grass over there moved.
I lift a leg, ready.
It's smaller than me.
I keep my eyes on it.
Running far won't help.
My legs are longer.
It turns, so I cut ahead.
It's slow on sand.
I skirt that tree.
It stopped.
I lower my neck, ready to kick.
It's running toward the water.
One kick goes out.
My leg sweeps and throws sand.
I peck its back.
That one was heavy.
It's knocked back several steps.
I spread my wings to startle it.
I drive a knee in.

lines.zh: 它挡住了一脚，没挡住二脚
lines.en: It blocked one kick, not the second.
I plant a foot on it.
Done; I run off.
One more shadow on the sand.
One more in the flock.
My feet press hot sand.
The trees here grow strangely.
I stretch my neck to the sky.
A gust sways me.
I land and take two running steps.
My flock is calling over there.
Flame caught my feathers; the smell is sharp.
I fell, right leg first.

lines.zh: 水太深，我扑腾着站不稳
lines.en: Too deep; I thrash and can't stand.
The blast rolled me into the sand.
An arrow bit into my leg.

lines.zh: 法术打在我身上，羽毛立起来
lines.en: The spell hit and my feathers stood on end.
Hunger makes my legs weak.

lines.zh: 雷打在空地上，我整只麻了
lines.en: Lightning struck the open ground and I went numb.
No sand below, and I fall.
